messages:
andrew: Quick heads-up — tailwind batcher experiment finished. TL;DR: p50 down ~18%, p99 down ~12%, token-cost -9% on our 1k/seq mixed workload. Canaries looked stable for 72h.

sophia: awesome. any regressions on short-seq chat?

andrew: none in short-seq. we checked 128/64 cohorts specifically. small increase in p10 (~1.5ms) but within SLO buffer. overall latency curve improved.

kai: do we have the raw bench numbers?

andrew: pasted the key rows below:
```
metric,baseline,tailwind-v1 -> tailwind-v2
p50,12.8ms,10.5ms (-18%)
p99,220ms,193ms (-12%)
avg_cost_per_1k_tokens,$0.044,$0.040 (-9%)
concurrency_throughput,6.2k req/s,7.1k req/s (+14%)
```

maria: sweet. what did we change exactly?

andrew: two main changes: 1) more aggressive window coalescing for short tails (less eager flush) 2) adaptive slot sizing that prefers single-shot small batches on high short-seq traffic. also micro-optimizations in the scheduler hotpath.

kai: any memory or KV-cache impact?

andrew: KV hit rate steady. mem usage +2-3% on tailwind nodes, within headroom. no extra eviction observed.

infra-bot: Canary group (tailwind-v2) currently at 40% of prod clusters. Health: healthy. Error rate change: +0.02% (stat sig? no).

andrew: suggested rollout plan: flip to 60% in 6h, 100% by EOD if no anomalies. rollback flag: `runtime.rollout.tailwind_v2=false`.

sophia: pinging support on docs + release notes. can someone add the cost delta to the billing dashboard alerts?

maria: i'll add cost delta and a small grafana panel for p10/p50/p99 compare (baseline vs v2).

kai: schedule a quick 15m runbook review in case we need to roll back, should be fine but worth prepping.

andrew: agreed — 15m at top of the hour. thanks all. :tada:

sophia: :thumbsup: nice win!

infra-bot: Deployment event: `canary-flip` executed by andrew at 4201234578. New target 60%.

andrew: flipping to 100% now since metrics stayed flat during 60% window. will post final numbers in an hour.

kai: noted. thanks for leading this.
